description: Somos Polaris, la brújula que guía nuestro camino hacia el descubrimiento. Así como la Estrella Polar ha orientado a los navegantes a través de la inmensidad del cosmos, nuestro equipo utiliza la física como luz para descifrar las leyes que rigen el universo. Unidos por la curiosidad y el rigor científico, transformamos preguntas complejas en conocimiento brillante.
summary: In this project, my team and I developed the story of the Opportunity rover ("Oppy") and created a mini-game in which Oppy narrates his journey on Mars. This is designed for kids aged 10 to 15. The project aims to make Oppy's story and NASA's documented findings more entertaining for young audiences. All of this is important so that kids can learn how information is gathered and where the data comes from for new missions like Artemis.
details:
Our project is both a story and an interactive game, offering a much more entertaining way to tell the story of Oppy. The main benefit of this approach is that kids prefer playing a game rather than just reading a traditional story. The impact my team and I expect is for children to learn about NASA's past missions in an engaging way.

For development, we used Twine to build the interactive experience and Google Docs to write the narrative and collaborate as a team. We also used Super Intelligence (SI / AI) tools to help debug errors in our code and improve the English grammar of our writing. Our team believes this project is creative because we do not just tell a story; we turn it into a game to make it much more attractive to young audiences. Finally, the key factors we considered were making sure the narrative was entertaining and capable of capturing the attention of kids aged 10 to 15.
projectRefs: NASA's Opportunity Rover Withstands Another Harsh Winter on Mars
